```diff
+ # Data Pipeline &amp; CLI Status Report
+ 
+ _Last Updated: &lt;!-- date placeholder --&gt;_
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This report summarizes the current implementation status, gaps, and recommended next steps for two closely-related workspaces in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection monorepo:
+ 
+ 1. **&#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96;** – reusable library of data-processing utilities &amp; directory structure that underpins ingestion workflows.
+ 2. **&#96;apps/cli&#96;** – TypeScript/Bun command-line interface that orchestrates data discovery, processing, review, and import into Xata.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 1. &#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96;
+ 
+ | Aspect | Status |
+ | ------ | ------ |
+ | Purpose | Provide reusable pipeline steps (backlog → processing → review → insertion) and helper utils for other workspaces. |
+ | Exports | &#96;index.ts&#96; re-exports 4 directory namespaces: &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;backlog&#96;, &#96;review&#96;, &#96;insertion&#96;. |
+ | Documentation | Minimal &#96;README.md&#96; with intended folder structure. |
+ | Implementation Coverage | **Low** – internal subfolders are present but largely empty or stubbed. |
+ | Tests | _None detected._ |
+ | Type Safety | Pending – no &#96;tsconfig.json&#96; inside package; relies on root settings. |
+ 
+ ### Key Findings
+ 
+ - Code inside the four pipeline folders is mostly missing, suggesting the library is in scaffolding stage.
+ - No explicit build / publish config – &#96;package.json&#96; lists no main / exports fields (not inspected yet).
+ 
+ ### TODO / Gaps
+ 
+ - Flesh out processors, validators, and utils as TypeScript modules.
+ - Add unit tests using Vitest/Jest.
+ - Configure package exports for consumers (&#96;types&#96;, &#96;main&#96;, &#96;module&#96;).
+ - Document public API surface in README.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 2. &#96;apps/cli&#96;
+ 
+ | Aspect | Status |
+ | ------ | ------ |
+ | Purpose | Provide interactive &amp; scripted CLI for data pipeline operations. |
+ | Docs | Comprehensive &#96;README.md&#96;, &#96;PLAN.md&#96;, rich internal docs. |
+ | Execution | Supports Bun &amp; Node (&#96;bun run&#96; / &#96;npm start&#96;), direct ts-node execution. |
+ | Commands Implemented | Based on README: &#96;process:*&#96;, &#96;review:*&#96;, &#96;import:*&#96;, &#96;insert:*&#96; plus interactive menu. Source folders &#96;commands/&#96;, &#96;scripts/&#96; mirror this. |
+ | Agents &amp; Extraction | &#96;agents/&#96;, &#96;extraction/&#96; exist – likely future AI helpers. |
+ | Build Output | &#96;dist/&#96; contains compiled JS. |
+ | Tests | _None detected._ |
+ 
+ ### Key Findings
+ 
+ - Command definitions likely live in &#96;src/commands/&#96;; need audit to confirm completeness.
+ - Environment variables &amp; config are clearly documented in README.
+ - Lacks automated tests &amp; CI.
+ 
+ ### TODO / Gaps
+ 
+ - Finalize command implementations (especially import flows to Xata).
+ - Integrate shared processors from &#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96; instead of local duplicates.
+ - Add unit/integration tests; mock Xata.
+ - Provide versioned changelog &amp; release workflow.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Risks &amp; Technical Debt
+ 
+ - Divergence between CLI-specific processors and shared library could cause duplication.
+ - Absence of tests increases risk of data corruption during import.
+ - No validation schemas observed; consider Zod/TypeBox for runtime validation.
+ 
+ ## Recommendations / Next Actions
+ 
+ 1. **Align library &amp; CLI** – implement core processors in &#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96; and import them into CLI commands.
+ 2. **Add validation &amp; error handling** – centralize schema definitions.
+ 3. **Testing &amp; CI** – introduce Vitest tests for processors and E2E CLI runs using fixture files.
+ 4. **Documentation** – expand README of data-pipeline; generate typedoc.
+
```

```diff
+ # Data Pipeline &amp; CLI – Product Requirements Document (PRD)
+ 
+ ## Document Purpose
+ 
+ Define functional and non-functional requirements for the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection **Data Processing Pipeline** package and companion **Command Line Interface** to ensure reliable ingestion of heterogeneous research data into the Xata database.
+ 
+ ## Scope
+ 
+ - Processing flow from raw source files → backlog → processing → human review → insertion → Xata.
+ - CLI tooling that exposes each stage and supports automation &amp; interactive workflows.
+ - Reusable TypeScript library (&#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96;) providing processors &amp; utilities.
+ 
+ ## Problem Statement
+ 
+ Researchers collect large volumes of documents (PDFs, transcripts, CSVs, etc.). Manual transformation &amp; import is error-prone and unscalable. We need a deterministic, testable pipeline and ergonomic CLI to standardize this workflow.
+ 
+ ## Goals &amp; Objectives
+ 
+ 1. Centralize transformation logic inside a versioned npm package.
+ 2. Provide an intuitive CLI with discoverable commands.
+ 3. Ensure data integrity via schema validation &amp; review gates.
+ 4. Enable batch &amp; incremental imports; support dry-run mode.
+ 5. Facilitate automated CI runs while supporting interactive human validation.
+ 
+ ## User Personas
+ 
+ | Persona | Needs |
+ | ------- | ----- |
+ | **Data Engineer** | Automate large batch imports, integrate in CI/CD. |
+ | **Research Analyst** | Run interactive commands to review &amp; approve data. |
+ | **Developer** | Extend processors or add new import workflows. |
+ 
+ ## Use-Cases
+ 
+ 1. **Initial Bulk Import** – ingest historical event documents.
+ 2. **Daily Incremental Import** – process newly discovered testimonies.
+ 3. **Quality Assurance** – analysts review processed JSON before DB insertion.
+ 4. **Automated Regression Test** – CI validates pipeline output against schemas.
+ 
+ ## Functional Requirements
+ 
+ ### F1. Data Pipeline Package
+ 
+ - F1.1 Export namespaced modules: &#96;backlog&#96;, &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;review&#96;, &#96;insertion&#96;.
+ - F1.2 Provide pluggable **processors** (e.g., &#96;textProcessor&#96;, &#96;jsonNormalizer&#96;).
+ - F1.3 Provide **validators** using Zod schemas.
+ - F1.4 Emit TypeScript types for external use.
+ 
+ ### F2. CLI
+ 
+ - F2.1 Global executable &#96;ut-cli&#96; alias.
+ - F2.2 Interactive menu when no args provided.
+ - F2.3 Command Groups:
+   - &#96;discover&#96; – scan source folders, move files to backlog.
+   - &#96;process&#96; – list/transform/enhance files.
+   - &#96;review&#96; – list/preview/approve/reject processed files.
+   - &#96;import&#96; – high-level workflows (events, sightings, etc.).
+   - &#96;insert&#96; – low-level Xata insertion helpers.
+ - F2.4 &#96;--dry-run&#96; flag for destructive operations.
+ - F2.5 Rich &#96;--help&#96; for all commands.
+ - F2.6 Support Bun &amp; Node runtimes.
+ 
+ ### F3. Integration
+ 
+ - F3.1 CLI commands must consume pipeline package processors – no duplicated logic.
+ - F3.2 Provide hooks/events for logging &amp; progress tracking.
+ 
+ ### F4. Configuration
+ 
+ - &#96;.env&#96; variables for Xata &amp; optional OpenAI keys.
+ - Yaml/JSON config file override for advanced settings.
+ 
+ ## Non-Functional Requirements
+ 
+ | Category | Requirement |
+ | -------- | ----------- |
+ | Performance | Process 1,000 small docs (&lt;1MB) under 5 min on M-series Mac. |
+ | Scalability | Handle multi-GB CSV via streaming processors. |
+ | Reliability | Unit test coverage ≥ 80%; CLI returns non-zero exit on failure. |
+ | Security | No secrets logged; sanitize file paths. |
+ | Maintainability | Follow monorepo coding standards; typed exports. |
+ 
+ ## Success Metrics
+ 
+ - &lt; 5% manual corrections needed post-import.
+ - CLI adoption by ≥ 3 internal teams.
+ - Pipeline package downloaded in ≥ 3 other workspaces.
+ 
+ ## Acceptance Criteria
+ 
+ - All functional requirements implemented &amp; tested.
+ - End-to-end import demo populates Xata with 100 sample events.
+ - CI workflow passes lint, test, type-check, and E2E scripts.
+ 
+ ## Timeline &amp; Milestones (Proposed)
+ 
+ | Milestone | Description | Target Date |
+ | --------- | ----------- | ----------- |
+ | M1 | Finalize architecture &amp; schemas | +2 weeks |
+ | M2 | Implement processors &amp; validators | +4 weeks |
+ | M3 | Implement CLI command skeletons | +5 weeks |
+ | M4 | Integrate pipeline with CLI | +6 weeks |
+ | M5 | Write tests &amp; documentation | +7 weeks |
+ | M6 | Beta release &amp; feedback cycle | +8 weeks |
+ | M7 | Production release v1.0 | +10 weeks |
+ 
+ ---
+ 
```

```diff
- # Ultraterrestrial CLI Status
- 
- ## Current Status
- **Last Updated: May 3, 2025**
- 
- The Ultraterrestrial CLI tool is a command-line interface for processing and importing data into the Xata database. Here is the current status of the implementation:
- 
- ### Core Features Implemented
- 
- - **Interactive Mode**: Fully functional interactive menu-based interface
- - **Command Structure**: All command categories (Onboarding, Processing, Review, Import, Database Operations)
- - **Data Processing Pipeline**: Complete bucket-based workflow system (Backlog → Processing → Review → Insertion → Database)
- - **Schema-Aware Operations**: Model Registry with validation rules based on Xata schema
- - **File Management**: Bucket Manager for handling file operations with metadata
- - **TypeScript Execution**: Direct TS execution without prior compilation
- 
- ### Key Components
- 
- | Component | Status | Notes |
+ # Ultraterrestrial CLI – **Current Status Report**
+ 
+ _Last updated: May 3 2025 (synchronized with DataPipelineCliReview &amp; PRD files)_
+ 
+ The **Ultraterrestrial CLI** (&#96;ut-cli&#96;) is a TypeScript/Bun command-line tool that orchestrates end-to-end data ingestion into the **Xata** database using a bucket-based workflow:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 📁 Source ➜ 📥 Backlog ➜ 🔄 Processing ➜ 🔎 Review ➜ 💾 Insertion ➜ 🗄️ Xata
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 1. Feature-Level Completion Matrix
+ 
+ | Area | Status | Notes |
+ |------|--------|-------|
+ | Interactive Menu | ✅ Complete | &#96;bin/cli.ts&#96; interactive flow with Inquirer menus. |
+ | **Command Groups** |  |  |
+ | Onboarding (&#96;onboard:*&#96;) | ✅ Complete | &#96;src/commands/onboard.ts&#96; handles discovery &amp; backlog promotion. |
+ | Processing (&#96;process:*&#96;) | ✅ _Core complete_ | Transform commands fully implemented; &#96;process:enhance&#96; currently **disabled** pending AI API keys. |
+ | Review (&#96;review:*&#96;) | ✅ Complete | Listing, preview, approve / reject flows implemented. |
+ | Import Workflows (&#96;import:*&#96;) | ⚠️ **Beta** | Event &amp; sighting imports implemented but require schema tuning and larger dataset testing. |
+ | Insertion (&#96;insertion:*&#96;) | ✅ Complete | Bulk &amp; batch insertion with Xata SDK; supports &#96;--force&#96; &amp; &#96;--update&#96;. |
+ | **Library Modules** |  |  |
+ | Model Registry | ✅ Complete | &#96;src/lib/model-registry.ts&#96; generates validation schema from mocked Xata schema. |
+ | Bucket Manager | ✅ Complete | Handles file IO &amp; metadata in bucket directories. |
+ | Validators | ✅ Complete | Field-level &amp; schema validation rules in &#96;src/lib/validators.ts&#96;. |
+ | File Manager | ✅ Complete | Abstractions for reading/writing files across buckets. |
+ | AI Assistant | ⛔ **Not Implemented** | Placeholder commented out in &#96;process:enhance&#96;. |
+ | Firecrawl Scraping | ⏳ Planned | Scaffold present in dependencies but not integrated. |
+ | **Quality &amp; Ops** |  |  |
+ | Unit Tests | 🚫 None | Needs Vitest/Jest coverage ≥ 80 %. |
+ | CI Workflow | 🚫 None | Integrate GitHub Actions for lint, type-check &amp; tests. |
+ | Documentation | ⚠️ Partial | README comprehensive; per-command docs still TODO. |
+ | Type Safety | ✅ Good | Strict TS config, generics; but no type tests. |
+ | Dependency Hygiene | ✅ | Uses &#96;commander&#96;, &#96;inquirer&#96;, &#96;chalk&#96;, etc.; no unused deps detected. |
+ 
+ Legend: ✅ Done ↔ ⚠️ Partial / Beta ↔ ⏳ Planned ↔ 🚫 Missing ↔ ⛔ Deprecated / disabled
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 2. Recent Highlights
+ 
+ - **Bucket Workflow Stable**: Backlog → Processing → Review → Insertion path tested with sample datasets.
+ - **Schema Validation**: Validators cross-reference Model Registry; warns on unknown fields.
+ - **Interactive UX**: Figlet banners and boxed sections improve discoverability for non-technical analysts.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 3. Known Gaps &amp; Next Actions
+ 
+ 1. **Re-enable AI Enhancement** (&#96;process:enhance&#96;)
+    • Acquire API keys, integrate &#96;aiAssistant.analyzeContent&#96; module.
+ 2. **Automated Tests &amp; CI**
+    • Add unit tests for lib modules &amp; command smoke tests.
+    • Configure GitHub Actions pipeline with Bun matrix.
+ 3. **Import Workflow Hardening**
+    • Expand event &amp; sighting transformers; add regression datasets.
+ 4. **Documentation Pass**
+    • Generate per-command markdown with examples (&#96;ut-cli &lt;cmd&gt; --help&#96;).
+ 5. **Firecrawl Integration**
+    • Implement &#96;discover&#96; sub-commands to scrape remote sources.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 4. Environment Configuration
+ 
+ The CLI reads &#96;.env&#96; from project root. Required variables:
+ 
+ | Variable | Purpose |
+ |----------|---------|
+ | &#96;XATA_API_KEY&#96; | API key for Xata SDK. |
+ | &#96;XATA_DATABASE_URL&#96; | Target database URL. |
+ | &#96;XATA_BRANCH&#96; | Database branch (default &#96;main&#96;). |
+ | _(optional)_ &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; | Enables AI enhancement feature. |
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 5. Roadmap Snapshot
+ 
+ | Milestone | Target | Owner |
  |-----------|--------|-------|
```

```diff
+ # Ultraterrestrial CLI – Product Requirements Document (CLI_APP_PRD)
+ 
+ ## 1. Purpose
+ 
+ Provide a robust, developer-friendly command-line application (&#96;ut-cli&#96;) for discovering, processing, validating, and importing heterogeneous research datasets into the **Xata** cloud database. The CLI must integrate seamlessly with the shared **Data Processing Pipeline** package while catering to both automation (CI/CD) and interactive analyst workflows.
+ 
+ ## 2. Background &amp; Problem Statement
+ 
+ The Ultraterrestrial project ingests thousands of event logs, testimonies, organization files, and sightings. Manual handling leads to inconsistent formats, data quality issues, and slow turnaround. A repeatable CLI pipeline is required to:
+ 
+ 1. Standardize transformations &amp; validation.
+ 2. Provide clear review checkpoints before database insertion.
+ 3. Support batch and incremental imports.
+ 4. Allow headless automation as well as guided interactive usage.
+ 
+ ## 3. Scope
+ 
+ In-scope:
+ 
+ - All code in &#96;apps/cli&#96; workspace.
+ - Bucket-based workflow (Backlog, Processing, Review, Insertion) on local filesystem.
+ - Integration with &#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96; processors &amp; validators.
+ - Import of **events** &amp; **sightings** records into Xata table(s).
+ - Interactive menu and discrete sub-commands.
+ 
+ Out-of-scope:
+ 
+ - Web UI; handled by &#96;agent-ui&#96;.
+ - Real-time streaming ingestion; future work.
+ - Advanced AI enrichment beyond minimal transform (**stretch goal**).
+ 
+ ## 4. Personas &amp; Use-Cases
+ 
+ | Persona | Use-Case |
+ |---------|----------|
+ | **Research Analyst** | Interactively discover new PDFs, process, preview JSON, approve, insert. |
+ | **Data Engineer** | Run &#96;ut-cli import:events --force&#96; in CI after nightly scraping. |
+ | **Developer** | Extend processors; dry-run tests locally. |
+ 
+ ## 5. Functional Requirements
+ 
+ ### FR-1 Interactive Workflow
+ 
+ - FR-1.1 No-arg execution launches Inquirer menu with progress visualization.
+ - FR-1.2 Menus for **Discover**, **Process**, **Review**, **Import**, **Insert**, **Status**, **Help**.
+ 
+ ### FR-2 Command Groups
+ 
+ - **Onboarding (&#96;onboard:*&#96;)**
+   - FR-2.1 Discover new files from path/pattern → Backlog.
+   - FR-2.2 Promote Backlog → Processing.
+ - **Processing (&#96;process:*&#96;)**
+   - FR-2.3 List, transform, (optionally enhance via AI) files.
+ - **Review (&#96;review:*&#96;)**
+   - FR-2.4 Validate JSON via &#96;validators.ts&#96;; approve/reject.
+ - **Import (&#96;import:*&#96;)**
+   - FR-2.5 End-to-end workflow for events &amp; sightings.
+ - **Insertion (&#96;insertion:*&#96;)**
+   - FR-2.6 Batch &amp; bulk Xata insertion with &#96;--force&#96; &amp; &#96;--update&#96; options.
+ 
+ ### FR-3 Validation &amp; Metadata
+ 
+ - FR-3.1 Each file carries adjacent &#96;.meta.json&#96; with status, quality score, etc.
+ - FR-3.2 Model Registry auto-generates schema from Xata, stored locally for offline validation.
+ 
+ ### FR-4 Configuration &amp; Extensibility
+ 
+ - FR-4.1 &#96;.env&#96; for API keys.
+ - FR-4.2 YAML config overrides per-project.
+ - FR-4.3 Pluggable processors (import via &#96;packages/data-pipeline&#96;).
+ 
+ ### FR-5 Automation
+ 
+ - FR-5.1 All commands runnable headless; exit codes 0/1 for success/failure.
+ - FR-5.2 &#96;--dry-run&#96; flag prints actions without side-effects.
+ 
+ ## 6. Non-Functional Requirements
+ 
+ | Category | Requirement |
+ | -------- | ----------- |
+ | Performance | Transform 1k &lt;1 MB files &lt; 5 min. |
+ | Reliability | ≥80 % unit test coverage; GitHub CI. |
+ | Security | No secrets logged; sanitize inputs. |
+ | Usability | Commands provide rich &#96;--help&#96; &amp; error messaging. |
+ | Portability | Works under Bun v1 and Node 20+. |
+ 
+ ## 7. Success Metrics
+ 
+ - Pipeline processes 10k historical records with &lt;5 % rejection.
+ - Avg. analyst review time per file &lt; 30 sec.
+ - CLI integrated into nightly CI jobs with 0 regressions for 30 days.
+ 
+ ## 8. Milestones
+ 
+ | ID | Milestone | Target Date |
+ |----|-----------|-------------|
+ | M1 | Core bucket workflow stable (Backlog→Insertion) | +2 weeks |
+ | M2 | Unit tests &amp; CI pipelines | +3 weeks |
+ | M3 | AI Enhancement re-enabled | +5 weeks |
+ | M4 | Firecrawl discover commands | +6 weeks |
+ | M5 | v1.0 Release &amp; documentation | +8 weeks |
+ 
+ ## 9. Risks &amp; Mitigations
+ 
+ | Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
+ |------|--------|-----------|
+ | AI cost spikes | ⬆ Expense | Keep enhancement optional, cache results. |
+ | Schema drift in Xata | Validation failures | Periodic schema sync script. |
+ | Large file memory | OOM | Use streaming transforms. |
+ 
+ ## 10. Open Questions
+ 
+ 1. Which OpenAI model &amp; cost constraints for enhancement?
+ 2. Firecrawl rate limits for daily scraping?
+ 3. Required data retention period for bucket files after insertion?
+ 
+ ---
+ _Approved by:_ TBD  
+ _Owners:_ @Data-Engineering-Team / @AI-Research-Team
+
```

```ts
import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai/dist";
```

```ts
import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai";
```

No other references exist.
